Original magenta backing, dark scene-card background and chroma fringe are artifacts, NOT artwork. Image 2 is approved chunky C02 cargo-crate STYLE ONLY: heavy dark contours, exaggerated solid shapes, broad matte material planes, and restrained two-to-three-step cel shading. A small flat cyan rectangular control/card pad projects below the main image. The main memory panel faces front-left, upright, a rounded rectangle with a thick pale-cyan rim and opaque muted-blue face. On that face preserve a simple dark-blue remembered industrial landscape: ONE taller narrow tower on the LEFT, two or three low angular buildings along the bottom, a distant low horizon and one or two broad pale-blue cloud shapes. Use broad iconic silhouettes, no tiny windows or lines. Reconstruct a compact complete outer housing rather than copying the source card's clipped rear/right edge. The projected panel remains a solid bounded illustrated graphic, not transparent glass or a glow sheet. No extra screen, human figure, eye, brain, magical orb, data text, archive labels, arrows, aura or background city outside the panel.
